# Kestrel Retirement Notice

Email notice from research IT to all group leaders, sent on 2026-03-16 by [[ilse-van-dorn]], announcing that the Kestrel cluster would be switched off on 2026-09-30.

## Summary

Kestrel, in service since 2017, would stop accepting jobs on 2026-09-16 and be powered off on 2026-09-30. Groups had to move or archive their data before then. Halyard accounts would open from 2026-04-01. Anything left on Kestrel storage after 2026-09-30 would be kept read-only for 30 days and then destroyed.

## Why It Matters

It started the [[halyard-cluster-migration]] and set its hard deadline. The 30-day grace period was the reason [[archive-kestrel-data]] insisted on an inventory signed off before power-off rather than after.

## Key Details

- No migration of user data by research IT; each group is responsible.
- Cold archive available for retired data, free of charge for 10 years, with a manifest required per batch.
- Kestrel's two GPU nodes would remain available until the last day, which the spatial pipeline relied on until September.

## Source Location

Group mailbox, folder `Admin/Compute/Kestrel`, message of 2026-03-16. Copy in group drive `Admin/Compute/Kestrel/retirement-notice.pdf`.
